ko.now.title: 툭이 지금
ko.hero.eyebrow: 게임 · 이야기 · AI 실험을 만드는 공개 작업실
ko.hero.note: 완성품보다 과정에 더 많은 흔적이 남습니다.
ko.deck.title: 길게 내리지 말고, 여기서 바로 골라봅니다.
ko.crew.title: 이 세계의 얼굴들.
ko.follow.title: 밖에서도 계속 이어집니다.
ko.projects.title: 지금 만들고 있는 것들.
ko.projects.desc: 프로젝트마다 상태, 공개 여부, 플랫폼, 현재 초점을 같은 규격으로 보여줍니다.
ko.activity.title: 흩어진 활동을 한곳에서.
ko.activity.desc: 외부 채널에 새 글이나 영상이 올라오면 TUKI WORLD가 공개 피드를 확인해 이 타임라인을 갱신합니다. 모든 활동이 TUKI LAB 글이 되는 것은 아닙니다.
ko.lab.title: 만드는 과정도 결과물입니다.
ko.lab.desc: 제작 기록, 실험, 수정, 공개, 회고, 결정을 한곳에 쌓습니다.
ko.lab.approvedDesc: 외부 활동을 그대로 복사하지 않고, 변화의 이유와 배운 점을 다시 정리한 정식 글입니다.
ko.lab.timelineDesc: 사이트 구조 변경, 수정, 결정처럼 긴 글이 필요하지 않은 이력까지 함께 남깁니다.
ko.about.desc: TUKI WORLD는 게임, 오리지널 IP, AI 활용 실험을 하나의 공개 제작 세계로 묶는 허브입니다.
ko.project.relatedDesc: 블로그와 영상에서 이 프로젝트와 자동 연결된 흔적입니다.
ko.common.emptyLab: 아직 승인된 정식 LAB 글이 없습니다. 후보 승인 후 이곳에 쌓입니다.
ko.common.emptyActivity: 아직 자동 수집된 활동이 없습니다. 첫 동기화 후 여기에 표시됩니다.
ko.article.missingDesc: 승인되지 않았거나 주소가 잘못된 LAB 글입니다.
ko.about.p1Desc: 완성도를 과장하지 않고 공개 여부와 현재 단계를 그대로 보여줍니다.
ko.about.p2Desc: 중단한 실험은 숨기지 않고 회고 기록으로 남깁니다.
ko.about.p3Desc: 각 프로젝트의 개성을 유지하면서 TUKI WORLD 안에서 이어집니다.
ko.hero.copyShort: 완성된 결과만 보여주지 않습니다. 만들고 실패하고 다시 고치는 과정까지 TUKI WORLD에 남깁니다.
ko.values.title: 우리는 이렇게 만듭니다.
ko.values.oneDesc: 아이디어만 던져두지 않습니다. 게임이든 이야기든 실제 결과물까지 만들어봅니다.
ko.values.twoDesc: 잘된 결과만 골라 보여주지 않습니다. 막힌 과정과 실패도 다음 제작을 위한 기록입니다.
ko.values.threeDesc: 한 번 만들었다고 끝내지 않습니다. 직접 써보고, 플레이하고, 다시 뜯어고칩니다.

en.brand.sub: Made with AI, fixed by TUKI.
en.now.title: TUKI Now
en.hero.eyebrow: A public workshop for games, stories, and AI experiments
en.hero.note: The process leaves more traces than the finished piece.
en.deck.title: Choose what you need here, without a long scroll.
en.crew.title: Faces of this world.
en.follow.title: The work continues elsewhere too.
en.projects.title: What I am building now.
en.projects.desc: Each project shows status, availability, platform, and current focus in one format.
en.activity.title: Scattered activity, one place.
en.activity.desc: When a new public post or video appears, TUKI WORLD checks the feed and updates this timeline. Not every activity becomes a TUKI LAB post.
en.lab.title: The process is part of the work.
en.lab.desc: Build logs, experiments, fixes, releases, postmortems, and decisions live here.
en.lab.approvedDesc: These are rewritten as original build notes about what changed, why it mattered, and what was learned.
en.lab.timelineDesc: Smaller changes such as site fixes, structural changes, and decisions live here too.
en.about.desc: TUKI WORLD is a public maker hub connecting games, original IP, and AI experiments.
en.project.logsDesc: Only approved records are connected here.
en.project.relatedDesc: Blog posts and videos automatically linked to this project.
en.common.emptyLab: No approved LAB posts yet. Approved candidates will appear here.
en.common.emptyActivity: No synced activity yet. It will appear after the first sync.
en.project.notFoundDesc: Please check the address and try again.
en.article.missingTitle: This record does not exist yet.
en.article.missingDesc: It may not be approved yet, or the address may be incorrect.
en.about.p1Desc: No inflated polish. Availability and current stage are shown as they are.
en.about.p2Desc: Stopped experiments are not hidden. They remain as postmortems.
en.about.p3Desc: Each project keeps its own identity while staying connected inside TUKI WORLD.
en.hero.copyShort: This is not just a showcase of finished work. TUKI WORLD keeps the making, failing, and rebuilding visible.
en.about.titleHtml:
Build it, break it,
fix it again.
en.values.title: This is how we make things.
en.values.oneDesc: Ideas do not stop at notes. Games and stories are pushed all the way into working results.
en.values.twoDesc: Only showing what worked would erase the useful part. Dead ends and mistakes stay in the record.
en.values.threeDesc: Finishing once is not the finish line. We use it, play it, break it, and rebuild it.

en.title: Started treating the AI-making process as a reusable record asset
en.summary: Decided to publish not only finished work but also experiments, failures, and fixes.

en.title: Reorganized projects across product, IP, and content axes
en.summary: Created a classification system for managing separate work inside one TUKI ecosystem.

en.title: Built the TUKI LAB repository and operating structure
en.summary: Created the first public-hub structure on GitHub Pages.

en.title: Redefined TUKI LAB as the workshop inside TUKI WORLD
en.summary: Separated roles: WORLD is the public hub and LAB is the build-history space.

en.title: Connected playable, publishing, and social links
en.summary: Linked only verified public destinations that can actually be visited.

en.title: Integrated project visuals and character areas into TUKI WORLD
en.summary: Connected real visual assets to project cards and the character section.

en.title: Applied official MOMO sprite and TUKI mascot, corrected game name
en.summary: Fixed incorrect character art and corrected the LUTRATIDE SURVIVORS name.

en.title: Applied TUKI WORLD Foundation v1.0 to the live structure
en.summary: Started normalizing navigation, statuses, assets, and content data under shared rules.

en.title: Built the Activity → Project → LAB approval pipeline
en.summary: External activity is linked to projects, grouped into LAB candidates, and only approved records become official posts and project history.

en.title: First TUKI WORLD UI v2 redesign
en.summary: Added a live banner, sticky world dock, floating TUKI NOW panel, and a console-style hero to move beyond a standard portfolio layout.

en.title: Condensed the TUKI WORLD home into a tabbed world deck
en.summary: Removed overlapping START HERE and EXPLORE flows and merged Projects, Activity, and Lab into one tabbed area to reduce scrolling and complexity.

en.title: Shifted TUKI WORLD from shape-led UI to real project imagery
en.summary: Reduced hero text collisions and made real project assets the visual focus with a project slider, large selector, signal timeline, and build-note UI.

en.title: Added Korean-first UI with Korean/English language switching
en.summary: Changed TUKI WORLD's default language to Korean and connected a bilingual system that switches major UI, project statuses, and build records from the header.

en.title: Applied the bright TUKI WORLD studio theme
en.summary: Reduced the dark-background footprint and shifted the site toward an ivory, mint, and yellow studio palette. Dark areas now remain mainly where they help project artwork stand out.
